scenes.name: kind-shark-departure
scenes.prompt: Create one landscape 3:2 hand-painted children's storybook illustration, watercolor and gouache with beautiful atmospheric detail, matching the supplied reference's traditional painted style. Reference identity: the same honey-brown wooden two-masted sailing ship with cream sails and a small red pennant, and the same natural blue-grey shark with white underside. The shark is KIND, a helpful calm guide, relaxed eye and gently closed mouth, no attack, no scary teeth. Keep recognizable ship structure and shark anatomy. No text, letters, labels, panels, collage, border, modern objects or UI. No recurring human heroes or dragon required; tiny indistinct sailors may appear on deck. Both ship and shark must be clearly visible. Scene one: sunny departure from a wooded bay. Eye-level split view above and below clear turquoise water. The ship glides toward the open sea to the right; the shark swims just ahead below the surface, showing the way. Green forested cliffs curve away behind, warm morning light, bright welcoming discovery, underwater sunbeams and little fish. Varied spacious wide composition.
